review_locator: PMCID:PMC9729788, An integrated cytokine and kynurenine network as the basis of neuroimmune communication; PMCID:PMC7704785, Astrocyte crosstalk in CNS inflammation
primary_title: IL-1beta Induced Cytokine Expression by Spinal Astrocytes Can Play a Role in the Maintenance of Chronic Inflammatory Pain
decision_basis: The neuroimmune reviews cite the primary spinal-astrocyte study reporting IL-1beta-induced cytokine and chemokine secretion, including GM-CSF, in primary spinal astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Measured GM-CSF/CSF2 protein secretion increased after IL-1beta stimulation of primary mouse spinal astrocytes and was attenuated by NF-kappaB inhibition; preserve spinal-astrocyte and chronic-pain context, distinguish secreted protein from Csf2 transcription, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting or terminal-TF mechanism.
